run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline for a given slab and adsorbate using a pretrained ML calculator
run_adsorb_ml_pipeline: run the adsorb_ml_pipeline to relax a slab, generate adsorbate-slab configurations, and detect anomalies
relax_atoms_with_ml: create a relax_job to relax atoms with an ML calculator and return energy and forces
generate_adsorbate_slab_configs: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab and list of adsorbates using ocp_adslab_generator
reference_adsorption_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to gas phase using atomic reference energies and slab energy
